gloss: sushi wrapped in bamboo grass leaves

definitions.gloss: sasa-zushi; pressed sushi wrapped in bamboo grass leaves
definitions.explanation: A regional pressed sushi, associated especially with Nagano and Niigata Prefectures, made by topping vinegared rice with ingredients such as fish, egg, or vegetables and wrapping each piece in a {笹|ささ} (bamboo grass) leaf, which adds fragrance and helps preserve the rice.

examples.english: In Nagano Prefecture, sasa-zushi has long been enjoyed as local cuisine.

notes:
{笹寿司|ささずし} is pressed sushi wrapped in ⟦{笹|ささ}→笹：04407_sasa⟧ leaves, a regional specialty most closely tied to {長野県|ながのけん} (Nagano) and {新潟県|にいがたけん} (Niigata).

The ⟦{笹|ささ}→笹：04407_sasa⟧ leaf has natural antimicrobial properties, and wrapping the rice in it both adds a subtle herbal fragrance and helps the sushi keep longer without refrigeration — useful in the mountainous regions where it developed.

Typical toppings include ⟦{鮭|さけ}→鮭：19337_sake⟧ (salmon), {錦糸卵|きんしたまご} (shredded thin omelet), and ⟦{山菜|さんさい}→山菜：12404_sansai⟧ (mountain vegetables), pressed onto small rice mounds and served on the leaf itself.
